Chapter 1214 - 27: Those Who Block The Galaxy, Body And Soul Shattered (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 1214: Chapter 27: Those Who Block the Galaxy, Body and Soul Shattered (Subscription Requested)

Fierce Sun Capital, isolated space.

Red Flame Venerable stared blankly at Lin Yuan.

The eyes of the other Peak Venerables were similar, looking at Lin Yuan with incredulity.

Take back the giant core column?

Currently, that giant core column has been occupied and refined by Fu Xu Venerate, this strongest venerable of the six ancient nations, with a single thought he could descend.

Moreover, beside the giant core column, there must be other Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Nation guarding with their main battle bodies.

Even if the Fierce Sun Ancient Country were to throw everything against Da Fu Ancient Country, using all ancient country weapons, the chance of taking down that giant core column is extremely low.

Let alone Lin Yuan going there alone.

"Galaxy, do not be impulsive," Red Flame Venerable immediately said: "Fu Xu Venerate’s strength is unfathomable; he has the ability to kill top-tier Peak Venerables."

Previously, Lin Yuan was able to survive against Fu Xu Venerate because this strongest venerable focused most of his attention on refining the giant core pillar, not paying attention to Lin Yuan, just smacking him away without any follow-up.

But now?

If Lin Yuan dares to go alone to that giant core column, Fu Xu Venerate would surely not mind taking action.

Strictly speaking, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, for the Da Fu Ancient Country, is also a threat; being able to eliminate a top-tier Peak Venerable ahead of time would be very advantageous for the Da Fu Ancient Country.

"I know Fu Xu Venerate is very strong."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The strongest venerables of the six ancient nations are comparable to the Invincible Great Saints of the Chaos Void.

This level of powerhouse either possesses absolute overwhelming advantages, such as mastering the fifth layer of "Infinite Void" Invincible Great Saint, whose internal universe compared to the same level Great Saint is not just a thousand times stronger?

Or they grasp special rule means, like Fu Xu Venerate’s chaotic time techniques, ordinary top-tier Peak Venerables can only passively take the hit.

"Rest assured, since I dare to go, I must have confidence."

Lin Yuan looked at the numerous Peak Venerables: "I’ve had a slight breakthrough in my power, I should not be weaker than Fu Xu Venerate."

As soon as these words were spoken.

Red Flame Venerable and other Fierce Sun Ancient Country Peak Venerables were shocked.

Not weaker than Fu Xu Venerate?

Isn’t that the level of the strongest venerable?

Galaxy Venerate has already reached this realm?

Red Flame Venerable and other Peak Venerables found it hard to believe.

Galaxy Venerate’s ancestral bloodline excavated to the venerable level, if in an immensely distant future, when one’s venerable level bloodline grows to the limit.

Reaching the level of the strongest venerable is still hopeful.

But how long after Lin Yuan stepped into the Heavenly Venerable Realm?

Though Red Flame Venerables found it somewhat unbelievable, looking at Lin Yuan’s expressions and tone, they chose to trust.

"Galaxy Venerate, why don’t you wait a bit longer? Until I arrive? Although my power is not comparable to Fu Xu Venerate, I carry numerous foundation weaponry, enough to restrain and counter that Fu Xu Venerate."

Red Flame Venerate immediately said.

If Lin Yuan’s strength truly isn’t weaker than Fu Xu Venerate, and their Fierce Sun Ancient Country deployed fully, there really is a great chance to take down that giant core column.

"No need."

Lin Yuan immediately refused.

This time, with his breakthrough in strength, he indeed has the thought of redeeming himself and retaking the giant core column.

But there’s no need to bring out all the trump cards and foundation of Fierce Sun Ancient Country, which are reserved for the last few hundred or even decades of the contest over treasure lands.

"Alright."

Red Flame Venerate nodded, not insisting.

He believed Lin Yuan must have a plan.

...

Outside the giant core column.

The air of heaven and earth felt like a quagmire, with black and white energies swirling. If viewed from millions of miles above, one would find at this moment, centered on the giant core column, a massive Black and White Yin Yang Tai Chi Diagram slowly forming.

Peak Venerables from Da Fu Ancient Country couldn’t help but feel suffocated, they looked at Lin Yuan with extreme solemnity, as if facing a formidable enemy.

As the instinct of the strong, they realized that the young man far away was terrifying, just by standing there without any aura emitted, made their numerous Peak Venerables’ hearts tremble.

What kind of power is this?

"Galaxy Venerate, is he the Galaxy Venerate from Fierce Sun Ancient Country?"

Some Peak Venerables from Da Fu Ancient Country recognized Lin Yuan; in fact, other venerables also simultaneously recognized Lin Yuan, but had no time to think deeply.

"Galaxy Venerate, be quick to leave, this is my Da Fu Ancient Country’s territory."

Fu Yu Venerate said solemnly, putting most of his focus around, he felt Galaxy Venerate dared to appear here must have a certain confidence, perhaps other top-tier Peak Venerables from Fierce Sun Ancient Country are ambushing nearby.

That oppressive aura making their hearts shiver might be sourced from here?

"Is it?"

Lin Yuan looked distantly at that imposing giant core column, smiling and said: "If you yield this pillar now, you can live."

"Yield the pillar?"

Fu Yu Venerate stared at Lin Yuan.

There’s always been only Da Fu Ancient Country treating other ancient countries like this. Since when does Fierce Sun Ancient Country dare treat Da Fu Ancient Country this way?

"Galaxy Venerate, let me come and meet you."

At this point, Fu Yun Venerable stepped out, looked at Lin Yuan with cold eyes.

Fu Yun Venerable is Da Fu Ancient Country’s top-tier Peak Venerable, in terms of strength, he’s by no means weaker than Lin Yuan before his breakthrough.

Rumble.

Time and space around Fu Yun Venerable transformed into clouds, rapidly enveloping toward Lin Yuan.

This is also Fu Yun Venerable’s attack method, using clouds to erode enemies, even top-tier Peak Venerables of the same class must be suppressed by these layers of clouds.

Fu Yu Venerate and other Peak Venerables merely watched coldly, not taking action themselves.
